headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Is Down 8.7% After Wells Fargo Flags Engagement Risks From YouTube And Rivals
headlines.summary: In recent days, Wells Fargo downgraded Netflix after flagging weaker viewer engagement and rising pressure from rivals such as YouTube, intensifying concerns about how much time subscribers spend on the platform. The downgrade has thrown a spotlight on whether Netflix’s push into formats like live sports, video podcasts, and short-form “Verts” can meaningfully revive engagement.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
